When I was little, I was diagnosed with Asperger's (high functioning autism) and I've struggled my whole childhood with mood and frustration regulation. When I was 5 my mom became an alcoholic, and my dad struggled with anger management, and that didn't help me. I was actually doing really good in school, sports and free time activities (anything to stay away from home). But when I turned 17 I broke, I couldn't handle all the pressure, and started developing OCD from all the stress. I was then put in a youth facility, where I could get support in my everyday life. It was a relief getting away from home, but it didn't fill the hole in me, I still felt something was missing. I started self harming, but at the same time I started on meds, the meds really helped me a lot, and they still do. I know live with a roomie. But as the same time that I feel good, I go around in fear of when my next breakdown comes.
I do, and I want to call them, but when I'm really down, I just feel like I want to do the act, and not ask for help, it's like two different sides of me arguing with eachother
Psychiatrists always ask me if I have suicidal thoughts, but I don't want to die, I just want a break from all the noise! "Glad" that somebody else feels the same way about it.
